changes.problem: A semantically correct legacy calculation_request failed the frozen v2.3 observations schema.
changes.resolution: Deterministically lower only reported value, evidence, period and unit bindings; ignore candidate operation and candidate-computed fields; execute the frozen framework DAG.

changes.problem: The v2.2/v2.3 dry-run fixture omitted required_value_terms and falsely blocked two P14 Stage B tasks before model calls.
changes.resolution: Construct candidate-path fixtures from both required qualifier literals and required value terms, preserving ordered fragments.

changes.problem: A compact task_ids layout registry reached a production evidence builder that requires one task_id per record.
changes.resolution: Reject compact, missing, invalid or duplicate task-page records before candidate inference.
